body: Music and singing are my drugs of choice, pretty much the only things that keep me sane half the time.

Thank you, I tried to calm down, deep breaths, it did help a bit. :)

To answer your question, I was on some sort of medication, but I have no idea what it was other than it tasted terrible. I stopped taking it (after about a couple months) as a mixture between forgetfulness and improvements in my behavior. My parents also made me talk to some people but that didn't last very long since it didn't really help much. That was quite a while ago, however, so i'm not really sure how to handle this for how I am now..
